label: Good
corporate_parent: Somerset Hardwood Flooring — independent, privately held. Somerset, KY.
manufacturing_location: Somerset, Kentucky, USA — single-source US manufacturing

species_grade.description: Character grade = NWFA #1 Common equivalent. Moderate natural marks — knots, mineral streaks, color variation. Not a defect — it's the desired aesthetic for many buyers.

finish_system.description: AlumaPLUS aluminum oxide finish — standard UV-cured aluminum oxide. Adequate scratch and wear resistance for residential use.

milling_precision.description: Standard milling — adequate for mid-tier. Not precision-grade like Carlisle or Mirage, but consistent enough for professional installation without excessive filler.

nwfa_certification.description: Independent inspection of manufacturing standards — grade, configuration, moisture content, average board length. Quality signal.

performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: Unlimited — 3/4" solid white oak. Same refinishing advantage as Carlisle but at mid-tier pricing.
performance_evidence.dimensional_stability: Good — standard kiln-dried solid. Width 3-1/4" to 5" is moderate risk for movement.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Standard solid — susceptible to cupping/crowning. Not for basements or radiant heat.

formaldehyde.status: CARB Phase 2 compliant — solid hardwood inherently low VOC

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: Solid hardwood — inherently very low formaldehyde emissions.
